title: psyllium suffruticosum
intro: Psyllium suffruticosum, commonly known as Indian gooseberry, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing cholesterol levels, managing diabetes, and promoting digestive health due to its ability to regulate bowel movements and alleviate constipation. The therapeutic actions of Psyllium suffruticosum are attributed to its mucilaginous properties, which help soothe and protect the gastrointestinal tract, and its antioxidant properties, which help reduce oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Psyllium suffruticosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
